description: First-order Trotter-Suzuki product formula. Approximates exp(-iHt) by splitting H into terms and applying each term's evolution sequentially for small time steps.
applicable_hamiltonians: Hamiltonians decomposable into a small number of terms
limitations: Error grows with commutator norms of Hamiltonian terms
Requires many steps for high accuracy on non-commuting terms
Not efficient for highly non-local Hamiltonians
First-order error scaling: O(t^2/n) — slower convergence than higher-order formulas

steps.description: Number of Trotter steps. Higher values give better accuracy at the cost of more gate operations.

execution.returns: Approximate time-evolution operator from first-order product formula.

complexity.gate_count: O(L * n) where L = number of Hamiltonian terms, n = Trotter steps

references.title: Generalized Trotter's formula and systematic approximants of exponential operators and inner derivations with applications to many-body problems
General theory of fractal path integrals with applications to many-body theories and statistical physics
